nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Main CI pipeline: formatting, lint, tests, licence check and sign-off verification. Runs on PRs and pushes to develop/main. Contains 7 jobs (rust, fmt, lint, test, deny, dco, ci-success) that gate merges. Tests run on 6 platforms (Linux x86_64, Linux x86_64 MSRV, Linux ARM64, Windows x86_64, Windows ARM64, macOS). Lints run on MSRV to prevent breaking contributor machines.

nodes.name: docs.yml
nodes.summary: Manual (mdBook) build and GitHub Pages deployment. On PRs touching docs/manual/: builds and checks internal links. On pushes to main: builds and publishes to https://mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar-plugin-manager/. Two jobs: build (mdBook install, build, link check) and deploy (GitHub Pages deployment).

nodes.name: publish.yml
nodes.summary: Triggers on GitHub release publication. Delegates to oxiguitar-packages' plugin-publish.yml reusable workflow to tell package repositories and winget about new releases. Requires PACKAGES_TOKEN and WINGET_TOKEN secrets.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: Test builds and release creation. Delegates to oxiguitar-packages' plugin-release.yml reusable workflow. Runs build-oxp.sh on Linux (x86_64, ARM64), Windows (x86_64, ARM64) and macOS. On PRs/develop/main: creates test builds with ~dev version. On v* tags: creates a DRAFT release; publishing the draft starts publish.yml.

nodes.name: ci-pipeline
nodes.summary: The CI pipeline orchestrates 7 jobs: rust (checks for Cargo.toml), fmt (rustfmt check), lint (clippy on MSRV + docs), test (6 platform matrix), deny (license/advisory check), dco (sign-off check on PRs), and ci-success (aggregates all results). Branch rules require ci-success before merging.

nodes.name: docs-pipeline
nodes.summary: The documentation pipeline builds the mdBook manual, checks internal links, and optionally deploys to GitHub Pages. Uses a pinned mdBook version with SHA256 verification.

nodes.name: release-pipeline
nodes.summary: The release pipeline coordinates test builds and tagged releases. On PRs/develop/main it creates test artifacts (kept 14 days). On v* tags it creates a draft release. Publish workflow sends events to package repos and winget.

nodes.name: ci-success-aggregation
nodes.summary: The ci-success job aggregates results from all other jobs. Passes only if every job passed (skipped is acceptable for DCO job on non-PR runs and Rust jobs without Cargo.toml). Fails on any failure or cancellation.
